caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: St. Maarten
caribbean.paragraph: St. Maarten in the Eastern Caribbean is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 21 kt and seas building to 4.9 ft with E swell at 8s periods. 38% rain probability -- isolated showers possible but conditions remain manageable.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Naples
mediterranean.paragraph: Naples in the Central Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 12 kt and seas building to 3.4 ft with SW swell at 5s periods. 38% rain probability -- isolated showers possible but conditions remain manageable.
